# Watch Bounty: The Outer Cut

*The Harbour Watch pays a bounty for the sawbills of the Old Cut's sea half, again and again.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Bain Harbour](../towns/bain_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Jowan](../npcs/jowan.md) |
| Level | 36 |

## Objectives

- Defeat 70 Sawbills ([Sawbill Fry](../monsters/sawbill_fry.md), [Sawbill](../monsters/sawbill.md), [Spitting Sawbill](../monsters/spitting_sawbill.md), [Pale Sawbill](../monsters/pale_sawbill.md))

## Rewards

- 5,881 EXP
- 504 mesos
- +20 standing with Bain Harbour

The first time you complete it instead: 8,821 EXP, 792 mesos, +30 standing with [Jowan](../npcs/jowan.md), +30 standing with Bain Harbour
